observed_support.missing_null_nonfinite_boolean: unsupported or invalid; never repaired to zero
observed_support.lost_fumbles: unique credited all-phase fumbles lost; sum disjoint phase credits only with event identity deduplication
observed_support.two_point_credit: passing, rushing and receiving each earn two; conversion catch does not add ordinary reception
observed_support.offensive_recovery: credited offensive recovery TD disjoint from ordinary rushing/receiving and return TD classes; no IDP exception
observed_support.returns: three explicit disjoint classes or independently verified exactly-three-class aggregate used once
observed_support.unlisted_fields: forced fumbles, ordinary recoveries, blocked kicks and return yards add no points

products.observed_score: all required observed components and played evidence
products.conditional_mean: sum weights times compatible component conditional means; fractional expected event counts allowed; joint simulator not required
products.median_quantile_interval_threshold: not supplied by sum of component medians; needs a qualified direct target or joint law
products.anytime_probability: not expected TD count and cannot fill a touchdown expectation

generic_provider_total: fantasy_points_ppr / pts_ppr is excluded unless separately established exact parity for this target

website_migration.required: explicit target version and source qualification; component attribution; matched chart-target forecast validation; consumer and fallback checks; preserve old product identity
website_migration.current_fallback: chart PPR unsupported; existing old-contract display must retain its old version

research.new_2025_football_labels: explicitly allowed by addendum section C
